rows.quote: (2) Outcome data for vitiligo: participants in the outcome-related genome-wide association studies (GWAS) studies included were mainly people of European ancestry who were included in the EBI database (GCST90436590), including 60 cases and 402,672 controls, and the UK Biobank database (ukb-a-115), including 95 cases and 337,064 controls.
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives a GWAS Catalog accession for the outcome data; no dictionary row carries it.
Sentence gives a database trait id and case/control counts; neither is an identifier or exact N of a dictionary row.
The name is used in the passages for outcome data, not for a protein dataset.

rows.quote: This study selected data from the baseline cohort, which described pQTLs in 34,557 participants of European ancestry.
